column1: # absent rows: 139 (one per named clade)   core_urclade rows: 69 (one per internal clade)
#   Name         : blank for exact/absent (auto-named); required for the core_* algorithms
#   Target_Clade : the focal clade for core_urclade / core_early_clade; blank otherwise
#   Clades       : components (exact), absent-from clades (absent), or ingroups (core_*)
# absent/urclade reference clades by clade_id_name; exact uses config GROUP names.
# ---- exact: PRESERVED curated metazoan building-block partition ----
# (exact is defined over composite_clades.groups; these use GROUP names, not clade_id_names)
# ---- absent: special outside-label row (NonMetazoa is the scope outside label, not a clade) ----
# ---- core_early_clade: the species70 unresolved (ambiguous) base of Metazoa ----
# ---- absent: one per named clade (members have ZERO species in the clade) ----
# ---- core_urclade: one per internal clade (target = clade; ingroups = its direct children) ----
